name: What is the process for an accessible kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an accessible kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific accessibility needs and design preferences. Next, we develop a customized design plan and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we handle all necessary permitting. Our skilled team then executes the remodel, keeping you informed at every stage. We prioritize efficient work and quality craftsmanship, concluding with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, design, permitting, execution, and a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
